title: Let's Learn IRISH DANCE! (START HERE)〡 (Part 1 of 5) Irish Dancing Basics Tutorial for Beginners!

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses a structured, step-by-step approach with clear verbal explanations and physical demonstrations. He breaks down movements using descriptive metaphors and helpful visual aids like contrasting socks.

lesson_structure.note: Welcomes viewers and introduces the beginner Irish dance tutorial series.
Explains foot distinction using a white sock and a black sock for easy following.
Breaks down the first point and switch-foot movement.
Introduces and explains the cut movement.
Teaches the reverse combination starting on the left foot.

cues: Touch the floor with our big toe
metaphors: imagine your leg is doing a dab
common_mistakes: Tripping yourself over when bringing the leg down

steps_taught.name: Point
steps_taught.description: Pointing the big toe forward onto the floor.

steps_taught.name: Switch Point
steps_taught.description: Switching feet to point with the opposite toe.

steps_taught.name: Cut
steps_taught.description: Bringing the foot up and over in a dab-like motion.

what_works: Using contrasting white and black socks to clearly identify left and right feet.
Showing both front and back view demonstrations so viewers can mirror easily.
what_hinders: Some explanations get slightly conversational and off-topic.

quotes.text: I have a white sock and a black sock and that's how we'll know what foot is the right foot.
It kind of feels like a karate chop.
Imagine your leg is doing a dab.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing camera showing his feet with one white sock and one black sock.
Teacher turns around to show the back view for foot placement orientation.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using mismatched colored socks (one white, one black) to teach left and right foot coordination.
